name: swift-ios
stack_notes: Prefer structured concurrency (async/await) and explicit state models
Avoid flakiness in UI tests by using expectations/conditions not sleeps
preferred_patterns: Use Swift Concurrency (async/await, Task) instead of manual thread management
Model workflows as explicit states (enums) and transitions; keep side effects at edges
Use Combine or async sequences where appropriate for reactive flows
Use XCTest expectations for async rather than sleeps
testing_rules: Unit tests for core logic with XCTest
Async tests must use XCTestExpectation/await, not sleeps
UI tests must use XCUIElement queries with waits/expectations
No network calls in unit tests; stub/mocks via protocol-based DI
allowed_exceptions: Time-based waits are only acceptable for genuine scheduling (not synchronization) and must be justified and bounded.
UI tests may use waitForExistence(timeout:) or XCTest expectations; do not use sleep.
reviewer_quality_gates: Explicit state models for multi-step workflows
No placeholder implementations in production paths
